label: Bible Study
prompt: Bear ye one another's _____, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verse: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
note: Shared weight is lighter weight — Paul calls that fulfilling the law of Christ.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I will both lay me down in peace, and _____: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
verse: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
note: An evening psalm of David: lie down in peace and actually sleep, because Someone else is keeping watch.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed _____.
verse: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
note: For Jesus' Jewish listeners, feeding swine was rock bottom — exactly where the prodigal son landed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: It is a _____ thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verse: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
note: The sobering close to one of Hebrews' sternest warnings — the same hands that save are not to be trifled with.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For godly sorrow worketh _____ to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verse: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
note: Godly sorrow 'worketh repentance'; worldly sorrow just works death. Paul's reminder that regret isn't repentance.
